visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit office interior where three women are engaged in separate activities. A woman in a blue oversized sweater sits in the foreground at a desk, her hands actively typing on a white keyboard while she maintains a focused, neutral expression. To the left background, another woman wearing a fuzzy light green sweater and glasses stands looking down at a mobile device held in her hands. In the right background, a third woman dressed in a white off-the-shoulder top and a grey pleated skirt is holding a phone to her ear as if in conversation, leaning against a white cabinet. The background features office desks, computers, and a large glass window showing a night city reflection. (2) The three women abruptly cease their individual tasks and converge toward the center of the frame, facing the camera with bright smiles and squinted eyes. They perform a series of synchronized dance movements, including rhythmic shoulder shimmies, hand-clapping gestures, and finger-heart signs directed at the lens. The woman in the blue sweater remains seated in her office chair but joins the upper-body choreography with precise hand motions, while the other two stand behind her, executing the routine with high energy. Their movements are fluid and repetitive, transitioning from pointing gestures to resting their chins on their hands.
